verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's `tofu test` command explicitly creates real infrastructure to test configuration and then destroys it, and workspaces/variables allow separate dev/staging/prod environments (multi-environment support mentioned in docs), which supports sandbox-style testing without touching production if configured with separate state/backends. However, there is no dedicated built-in sandboxing feature, no first-party guidance on isolating a sandbox from production data specifically, and no mocking/dry-run-only testing mode beyond plan preview. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/mock-infrastructure feature, explicit doc guidance on isolating prod vs sandbox state, independent verification of test-command safety in practice.
